mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and SPX 20d returns is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, leading to a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 5.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle, which initially causes equity market volatility but leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in the end of the cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term (CPIAUCSL * FEDFUNDS) is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by GDP growth above 3.0% and housing starts above 1800 thousand units), strong housing starts (HOUST) signal continued consumer spending strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 > 3.0% and HOUST > 1800, or the Rank IC for HOUST in the late-cycle regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 115.0 (index 2017=100) signals robust manufacturing activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth accelerates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 115.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals disinflation, which reduces the risk of aggressive monetary tightening and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0% YoY, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS) above 370,000 million dollars signal robust consumer spending, which drives corporate revenue growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 370000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) above 136,000 thousand persons signals a tight labor market, leading to higher corporate profit margins and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 136000, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
